'task dispatch' and 'mount/snapshot' are one and two cells shorter than 'dispatch tasks'/'mounts / snapshots' because a tb rank gap is sized to its longest label and the 3-rank v3 overflowed by one row otherwise (attempts-raw/v3-dispatch-fan-a-check.txt: 57x48).
blockers: Pane size: the harness splits a half pane of this session's tab, which measured 83x51 @100%, not 77x47. The target-size fit is proven by pinned COLUMNS=77 LINES=47 dumps (pinned/*-77x47-frames.txt, no 'overflows' banner, 'viewport: 77x47 zoom: 1.00 natural').

Renderer gap (structural, not worked around): in tb the rank gap is sized to the longest label in it, and in lr a rank gap is ~2x the label width, so a labelled chain of 3+ stages cannot fit 77x47 at natural zoom with 13-17 cell labels. A 2-node tb pair cannot carry a 13-cell label either: the extent is only as wide as the boxes.
